acceptance_criterion: Stripping and filling carried out with qualified fill, watered and compacted, deformations and settlement rectified at final levelling, and covered with gravel.

work_package: Perimetral & Internal Roads and Site Accesses
acceptance_criterion: No dead-end road without sufficient turning area for operation and maintenance vehicles. Roads constructed and compacted according to the geotechnical report.
Fence posts at least 2 m above ground at a maximum spacing of 3 m, each with a 50 cm gooseneck bend at 45 degrees.
Fence mesh grid at most 50 x 50 mm with a minimum wire thickness of 3 mm.
At least one pedestrian gate 2 m high by 1.5 m wide and one sliding vehicle gate 2.5 m high by 6 m wide.

At least three rows of horizontal or diagonal tension wires; three rows of barbed wire each at least 40 cm high; 45 cm diameter spiral razor wire above and a further 45 cm spiral razor wire laid on the ground on the plant side.
Fence post bases dome-shaped to shed water. Basin-shaped concrete that can pool water is not accepted.
A 3 m wide gravel layer is applied in all areas between the perimeter fence and the PV modules throughout the site.
Road surfaces sloped toward both edges of the access roads for stormwater drainage; slopes maintained to ensure adequate water movement.

Total structure height must not exceed the 2.30 m limit set as an authorisation mitigation measure. The 2P configuration at 20 degrees with 60 cm ground clearance reaches 2.24 m, leaving 6 cm of tolerance.
source: Schedule 13B - Contractor's Scope of Work Q&A rev.2 dated 25.02.2026

acceptance_criterion: Embedment depth of 1.5 m assumed. The pull-out test results govern the required embedment; any additional length is a variation at EUR 2.60 per pole per 10 cm.
source: Schedule 13B - Contractor's Scope of Work Q&A rev.2 dated 25.02.2026

acceptance_criterion: Incomplete or faulty manufacturing and equipment detected during inspection and testing is corrected within 15 days at the latest.

Investor acceptance tests are carried out by the Investor and the technical audit company within 15 working days at the latest following DSO acceptance. DSO acceptance does not constitute acceptance by the Investor.

AC/DC circuit tests; 100% IV and polarity tests on strings; MV, LV AC and DC cabling insulation resistance tests; thermography of modules and other heating equipment; equipotential and grounding measurements.
